stemMd: Exactly one of Ada, Bruno and Cleo has a key. Ada says: Bruno has the key. Bruno says: I do not have the key. Cleo says: Ada does not have the key. Exactly one statement is true. Who has the key?
explanationMd: If Ada has it, only Bruno's denial is true. If Bruno has it, Ada and Cleo both tell the truth. If Cleo has it, Bruno and Cleo both tell the truth. Only Ada as key holder makes exactly one statement true.

distractorRationale.c: Then Ada and Cleo both make true statements.
distractorRationale.d: Then Bruno and Cleo both make true statements.
distractorRationale.e: Exactly one person has the key.
distractorRationale.b: The premise guarantees one key holder.
